pages.title: Overview
pages.text: The Grumblager is a compact Raider with 14 health. It appears in every raid wave and spawns with an Iron Sword, Bow, or Crossbow.$(br2)Its held weapon determines whether it fights in melee, with a bow, or with a crossbow.

pages.name: Grumblager
pages.text: Grumblagers can wear mixtures of leather and chainmail armor.

pages.title: Recruited Armor
pages.text: Changing a recruited Grumblager's armor is disabled by default. When the server enables this option, its owner can right-click it with an armor piece to equip that slot. Any replaced piece drops on the ground.
